issues.description: The apply_single_qubit_gate function parameter order is inconsistent between the problem description / solution and the template stub. The problem statement (and the solution implementation) describe/apply apply_single_qubit_gate(state, gate, site) (state first, gate second), while the template stub declares apply_single_qubit_gate(gate, state, site) (gate first, state second). This mismatch impedes a clear mapping from the written task to the provided starter code: students reading the problem or looking at the solution will expect the state to be the first argument, but the template stub's signature suggests the opposite, which can cause confusion and lead to incorrect implementations or failing tests.
issues.suggested_fix: Align the template stub signature with the problem description and solution by changing the template function declaration to: def apply_single_qubit_gate(state: list[NDArray[np.complex128]], gate: NDArray[np.complex128], site: int):. Alternatively, if the template intentionally uses the reversed order, update the problem statement and solution to match the template; but the recommended fix is to make the template match the problem/solution to avoid cognitive mismatch.
